d: Jarmani men onlain gem khelne valon ka samna kaee tarah ke nazi kantent se aasani se ho sakta hai, phir vo hitlar ke mim hon, svastik ya phir “zig hail” jaise nare. yun to zyadatar plaitfarm niymon ke dayre men aate hain, lekin geming se jure formon men dhur-dakshipanthi vichardhara phailti ja rahi hai.
